title: Business English Conversation 27:  Company Dress Code
content: 1. a company dress code: the rules or policy for what employees can and cannot wear to work - We have a very strict company dress code. Every employee must wear formal business attire. - Does your company have a company dress code or can you where whatever you want? 2. business attire: clothes appropriate for business - All employees must wear appropriate business attire. - The boss told him to wear business attire, but he showed up wearing jeans and a T-shirt. The boss was very angry. 3. to dress casually: to dress in a more relaxed and less formal way - We can dress casually at my company. - Salesman must dress formally at my company, but engineers can dress casually.
